sources.title: Wegovy cardiovascular indication approval March8 2024
sources.excerpt: Randomized multinational multicenter placebo-controlled double-blind trial over17,600 participants, standard-of-care plus lifestyle counseling in both groups. Cardiovascular death, heart attack or stroke occurred in6.5% Wegovy versus8% placebo. Indication adults with cardiovascular disease and obesity/overweight, not general primary prevention. Boxed thyroid C-cell tumor warning; MTC/MEN2 contraindications, GI/pancreatitis/gallbladder/other warnings.
